The '''Uggli Brothers''' gang was a group of [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]], centered on [[Kiffex/Legends|Kiffex]]. Most of their members did, in fact, have deformities or were otherwise unattractive examples of their [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="Legacy 35" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
In the German translation of this story, "Uggli brothers" was translated as "hässliche Brüder," which means "ugly brothers."
